title: Copilot Studio: web browsing for agents on the Microsoft Copilot harness

reasons: published before the check existed: kept live with a notice while a corrected version is prepared

summary: Hold: the maker configuration path omits documented steps and substitutes a description for the Access control setting label. The statement that allow lists are not enforced centrally also exceeds the evidence; Microsoft documents maker-side configuration and separately recommends machine-level browser policies.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls: first table row
claims.claim: The environment computer-use toggle is at Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > Computer use.
claims.quote: select Manage and then select Environments ... Select the environment to update ... select Settings ... Expand Product, and then select Features ... Scroll to Computer use and turn off the toggle.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls: first table row and following prose
claims.claim: The Power Platform CLI command pac env update-settings --environment <environment-id> --name iscomputeruseinmcsenabled --value false disables computer use in an environment.
claims.quote:
Run the following command to disable the setting:
pac env update-settings --environment <envid> --name iscomputeruseinmcsenabled --value false

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls: second table row and following prose
claims.claim: The tenant hosted-browser toggle is at Power Platform admin center > Manage > Tenant settings > Hosted browser in computer use.
claims.quote: To disable the hosted browser in a tenant: ... select Manage and then select Tenant settings ... Select Hosted browser in computer use. A pane opens. ... Turn off the toggle.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls: second table row and following prose
claims.claim: No automation equivalent or Set-TenantSettings property is documented for the hosted-browser toggle, unlike the environment switch.
claims.quote: Searched: computer use Set-TenantSettings hosted browser. Read administer-computer-use, power-platform/admin/tenant-settings, powerapps-powershell, and powershell/module/microsoft.powerapps.administration.powershell/set-tenantsettings; no hosted-browser property or equivalent call was documented.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls: third table row
claims.claim: The maker path for site restrictions and HTTPS is Tools > Computer use > allow list and Enforce HTTPS.
claims.quote: Go to the Tools page for your agent and select Add tool. ... select New tool. ... Select Computer use. ... Select Add and configure. ... Access control ... Enforce HTTPS
claims.fix: Replace the path in front matter and the rendered table with 'Tools > Add tool > New tool > Computer use > Add and configure > Access control / Enforce HTTPS'. Explain that instructions are supplied before Add and configure, and that Access control and Enforce HTTPS are separate options on that configuration page. The current final label does not exist.

claims.where: controls[2].api; Governance controls: third table row and following prose

claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio computer use Enforce HTTPS API; computer use allow list API configuration centrally. Read computer-use, administer-computer-use and computer-use-standalone search excerpts; found configuration UI but no corresponding published API or command.

claims.where: controls[3].ui; controls[3].api; controls[3].note; Governance controls: fourth table row
claims.claim: No separate UI or API switch is documented specifically for native web browsing on the Microsoft Copilot harness.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Copilot harness web browsing controls pricing; Microsoft Copilot harness computer use default browsing. Read roadmap, administer-computer-use and harnesses-overview; agents-experience/overview comparison calls harness computer use Planned, with no switch given.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed that existing computer-use controls apply to the planned harness capability.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Copilot harness web browsing computer use pricing default enabled controls; Microsoft Copilot harness computer use default browsing. Read computer-use and administer-computer-use, both explicitly scoped to standard harness; no extension to native harness browsing found.

claims.where: controls[2].scope, note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls: following prose
claims.claim: Makers configure site allow lists and Enforce HTTPS within an agent's computer-use tool configuration.
claims.quote: The configuration page includes optional fields ... Access control ... enable access control to define the specific URLs and desktop applications that computer use should be limited to. ... Turn on Enforce HTTPS

claims.claim: Allow lists are not enforced centrally.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio computer use centrally allow; computer use allow list API configuration centrally. Read computer-use and configure-where-computer-use-runs; maker configuration is documented, but no blanket absence of central enforcement is stated. Learn also recommends Edge policies via Intune.
claims.fix: Replace the absolute statement with 'The Access control allow list is configured in the computer-use tool by its maker; no tenant-wide administration surface for that list is documented as of November 2026.' If discussing other controls, note that Learn recommends Edge policies via Intune for managed machines, while the hosted browser is not managed by the tenant's Intune policies. Cite computer-use#best-practices and configure-where-computer-use-runs.

claims.claim: Connector data policies and endpoint filtering provide administrator-side restrictions on agents' access to services.
claims.quote: Data policies let you govern how agents connect and interact with data and services ... Alternatively, if you want to allow or deny specific HTTP endpoints instead of blocking all HTTP calls, use endpoint filtering.
claims.fix: Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-data-loss-prevention and narrow the sentence to connector access and supported HTTP/knowledge-source endpoints. State that this documentation does not establish a website allow list for native harness computer-use browsing.

claims.claim: Handling authenticated websites and downloaded files remains undocumented for this planned native harness browsing capability.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Copilot harness web browsing download authentication; Microsoft Copilot harness web browsing computer use pricing default enabled controls. Read roadmap, computer-use and harnesses-overview; results describe standard-harness credentials or other products, not this planned capability.

claims.claim: The governance checklist asks readers to review controls that have no corresponding control rows.
claims.quote: Review data policies and external model settings. ... Require human approval for sensitive actions. ... Review run logs and credit use. No corresponding rows appear among the table's four controls.
claims.fix: Add rows for the data-policy, external-model and approval controls the checklist recommends, with documented surfaces and explicit applicability caveats for the planned capability. Represent monitoring controls if readers are asked to configure them; otherwise keep log and credit review as operational advice rather than implying an undocumented control.

claims.claim: The prepare action rating treats this as a change that arrives without a maker choosing it.
claims.quote: action: prepare; defaultState: unknown; Open questions: Whether computer use controls apply to the harness capability. The roadmap describes a new capability, not a mandatory replacement or automatic change to existing agents.
claims.fix: Set action to 'review'. The standard assigns review to a new capability with an unstated default when no source says existing behaviour changes automatically; the roadmap supplies no such statement.
